behaviours.name: Hammer of Kings (first tick)
behaviours.quote: dealing ${$804752m1+$804752ppl1+$AP*0.12+$sph*0.22} Holyfire Damage to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: 804751 Effect[0] aura 23 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 3000 ($t1), trigger 804752 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, TARGET_DEST_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY), DurationIndex 29 (12000 ms, $d). $804752m1 = BasePoints 4 + 1 = 5, per level 37.6 truncated to 37 at level 60 (SpellInfo.cpp:497), AP 70 x 0.12 = 8.4, spell power 0: 50.4, read as 50 after the int32 truncation of CalcValue (base pair verdict 804751 effect_value 804752e0 #0). One real cast of 804751 with the dummy 5 yd away, spell crit and spell penetration fixtures 984954 and 823764 on the caster (harness precondition fixtures): the damage of 804752 on the dummy read 3500 ms after the cast. Control (before): no cast, 0.

behaviours.name: Hammer of Kings (first tick at +20000 attack power)
behaviours.quote: dealing ${$804752m1+$804752ppl1+$AP*0.12+$sph*0.22} Holyfire Damage to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: As first_tick with 20000 more attack power (player_attack_power, harness fixture): 42 (5 + 37) + int32(0.12 x (70 + 20000)) = 42 + 2408 = 2450, against 50 at the reference. Control (before): no cast, 0; the contrast on the same build is the first_tick entry at the reference attack power.

behaviours.name: Hammer of Kings (first tick at +20000 spell power)
behaviours.quote: dealing ${$804752m1+$804752ppl1+$AP*0.12+$sph*0.22} Holyfire Damage to nearby enemies
behaviours.observe_source: As first_tick with 20000 spell power (player_spell_power hit_arm, harness fixture; the Holy spell power read before the reading is recorded on the verdict): 42 + int32(0.12 x 70) + int32(0.22 x 20000) = 42 + 8 + 4400 = 4450, against 50 at the reference. Control (before): no cast, 0; the contrast on the same build is the first_tick entry at spell power 0.

behaviours.name: Solar Invigoration (allies take increased healing, Sunlight heals)
behaviours.observe_source: 806123 Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT, MiscValue 127, BasePoints 19 (20, $s2). The grouped ally's Illumination 500143 heals are read without and with a real cast of 806123 on the caster (the area aura reaches the ally), the ally held at 50% health; 20000 spell power on the caster (harness fixture) so the stat part dominates the die. Control arm: no cast.

behaviours.name: Solar Invigoration (lasts 15 sec)
behaviours.observe_source: 806123 DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms, $d). One real cast of 806123 on the caster: its aura is present when read 13500..14500 ms after the cast (game time) and gone when read 16500..17500 ms after it, so the duration lies between 13500 and 16500, within 10% of 15000 on both sides (the held / ends pair of the Crypt Plague ticks entry). Control (before): no cast, absent.

behaviours.name: Solar Invigoration (second damage 2.6 s later gives no Illumination)
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once every 3 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 806123 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:83-85, 338-340: the aura holder's direct damage that is not derived casts Illumination 502429 on itself and sets a 3000 ms gate). 502429 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, BasePoints 1228, DieSides 142, no per-level term at BaseLevel 60: m1 = 1229..1370, spell power 0. 806123 cast on the caster (the area aura reaches it) then Gavel of Wrath 802561 at the dummy; control (before): the same Gavel without the aura. Horusath Blast 572801 then Gavel of Wrath 802561 (Gavels share a 5000 ms category cooldown, so another direct damage spell is the first) 2600 ms apart: one Illumination (the second is inside the 3 s gate, excluding a gate under 2.6 s).

behaviours.name: Solar Invigoration (second damage 3.4 s later gives a second Illumination)
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once every 3 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 806123 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:83-85, 338-340: the aura holder's direct damage that is not derived casts Illumination 502429 on itself and sets a 3000 ms gate). 502429 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, BasePoints 1228, DieSides 142, no per-level term at BaseLevel 60: m1 = 1229..1370, spell power 0. 806123 cast on the caster (the area aura reaches it) then Gavel of Wrath 802561 at the dummy; control (before): the same Gavel without the aura. Horusath Blast 572801 then Gavel of Wrath 802561 (Gavels share a 5000 ms category cooldown, so another direct damage spell is the first) 3400 ms apart: two Illuminations (excluding a gate over 3.4 s).

behaviours.name: Circle of Valor (damage divert)
behaviours.quote: Allies that stand inside of it will divert $560347s1% of all damage taken to the caster,
behaviours.observe_source: $560347s1 = 30 (560347 EffectBasePoints[0] 29 + 1). 520647 Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 560347 on the caster with TARGET_DEST_DYNOBJ_ALLY: 560347 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_PARTY, aura 81 SPELL_AURA_SPLIT_DAMAGE_PCT, MiscValue 127. As Gaze of the Black Knight 802138: Light of the Naaru 41394 strikes the grouped ally; the control arm has no circle (0 transferred), the circle arm has 520647 cast at the caster's position (the ally stands inside its 10 yd), and the caster must take floor(30% of the strike's damage plus absorbed amount) under 560347.

behaviours.name: Circle of Valor (ten heal ticks)
behaviours.observe_source: 520647 Effect[0] PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA, aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 1500 ms (EffectAmplitude, $T1), duration 15000 ms (DurationIndex 8, $d), radius index 13 (10 yd, $a1); it triggers 520648 (Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50). $520648m1 = 50, AP 70 x 0.125 = 8.75, spell power 0: 58.75. One real cast of 520647 at the caster's position, the caster held at 30% health (the circle covers it); heals of 520648 on the caster read 16500 ms after the cast: 10 heal events (15000 / 1500), excluding a period or duration 10% off on either side (9 or 11 events).. Control (before): no cast, 0.
